_comment: The RISING FLOOR for the legacy suite.
The Laravel application is the ORACLE for the Go rewrite: it is the
reference implementation the Go port is compared against, byte for byte,
endpoint by endpoint. A test that is deleted is therefore a silent
reduction in the definition of "identical", and a suite that shrinks is
the oracle losing the ability to judge.
So the count is a FLOOR, not a report. It may only go UP. Raising it is
free; lowering it requires deleting this file's value AND writing down

and re-measured after the Week 1 defect fixes (B1-B19), the contract
